# Tables the signed-in database roles (authenticated and anon) hold no INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE on, at table or column level.
# Read from production on 28-10-2026 (157 tables). A write to one of these made on the caller's own session is refused with 42501
# in production, whatever a test double accepts, so `test_a_write_of_a_table_the_signed_in_role_cannot_write_...` holds every writer
# to a client that can. A table leaves this list when a migration grants the signed-in role a write back (then its writers may use the
# caller's session); a table joins it in the migration that takes the write away. The real-Postgres half checks each name here that
# exists in the migration-built database against the privileges themselves.
# Joined by a migration in the change that moves its writers (the first line below the names is the migration): 559 closes
# receipts, receipt_allocations, purchase_payments, purchase_payment_allocations and the three note-allocation tables.
# 562 closes the seventeen
# firm-level tables of POST-A-329 (account_group_mappings, firm_hsn_library, firm_hsn_rate_history, assignment_rules, entities, entity_relationships,
# entity_to_entity_relationships, leads, dsc_records, automation_rules, automation_executions, reminder_settings, engagement_templates and the three
# recurring-template parents, task_escalations).
# 563 closes the six document headers and their six lines tables of POST-A-335 part 2 (client_sales_invoices, purchase_bills, credit_notes,
# debit_notes, purchase_credit_notes, sales_debit_notes and the six lines tables).
# 564 closes tds_lower_deduction_certificates (POST-A-359): the s.197 certificate is recorded by the API since POST-A-293.
# 583 closes einvoice_records, eway_bill_records and self_assessment_challans (POST-A-394): the IRN and e-way bill records and the section 140A challans are written by the API's privileged client since the change that shipped before it.
# 590 creates journal_narration_templates (POST-A-093) with no signed-in write: its writers are the API's privileged client from the start.
# 591 creates fixed_asset_movements (POST-A-112) with no signed-in write: record_fixed_asset_movement, called by the API's privileged client, is its one writer.
# 592 creates fixed_asset_verifications and fixed_asset_verification_findings (POST-A-112) with no signed-in write: the API's privileged client opens a count, and record_fixed_asset_finding and close_fixed_asset_verification are the only other writers.
# 593 closes tds_deductions, tds_returns, tds_challans and tds_certificates (POST-A-443): the TDS register, returns, challans and certificates are written by the API's privileged client since the change that shipped before it.
# 595 closes itc_reversal_register, gstr2b_uploads, gst_sync_jobs, gst_portal_snapshots, client_gst_turnover, hsn_sac_preferences and gst_challans (POST-A-008, the GST tranche): the API writes the first six with its privileged client since the change that shipped before it, and nothing writes gst_challans.
# 596 closes ais_uploads, ais_records, ais_reconciliations, ais_computation_decisions, form_26as_records, income_tax_asset_blocks, income_tax_worksheets, itr_filing_versions, tax_deduction_claims, it_deductions and tax_notices (POST-A-008, the income-tax tranche): the API writes the first nine with its privileged client since the change that shipped before it, and nothing reads or writes the last two.
# 597 closes schedule_iii_ratio_explanations, schedule_iii_ratio_inputs, schedule_iii_unbilled_reviews, account_budgets, cost_centres, year_end_checklist_items, year_end_checklists, year_end_reviews and notes_to_accounts (POST-A-008, the accounting tranche): the API writes the first six with its privileged client since the change that shipped before it, and nothing reads or writes the last three.
# 598 closes capital_work_in_progress, cwip_additions, godowns, inventory_batches and purchase_bill_landed_costs (POST-A-008, the stock tranche): the API writes all five with its privileged client since the change that shipped before it.
# 599 closes client_lifecycle_events, client_period_metrics, health_overrides, client_health_scores, health_dimension_scores and client_health_overrides (POST-A-008, the health tranche): the API writes the first three with its privileged client since the change that shipped before it, and nothing reads or writes the last three.
# 600 closes billing_schedules, recurring_invoice_template_lines, recurring_purchase_bill_template_lines, recurring_invoice_runs, recurring_purchase_bill_runs and recurring_journal_runs (POST-A-008, the recurring-billing tranche): the API writes all six with its privileged client since the change that shipped before it.
# 601 closes invoice_deliveries and customer_statement_deliveries (POST-A-008, the deliveries tranche): the API writes both with its privileged client since the change that shipped before it.
# 602 closes msme_payments, msme_vendors, retainer_clients, suppliers and ledger_balances (POST-A-008, the unwritten tables): nothing in the API, the browser or a database function writes them.
# 603 closes onboarding_checklists, onboarding_checklist_steps, onboarding_tasks, proposals and engagement_events (POST-A-008, the onboarding tranche): the API writes all five with its privileged client since the change that shipped before it.
# 604 closes entity_roles, properties, related_party_loans and dtaa_treaty_rates (POST-A-008, the relationships tranche): the API writes all four with its privileged client since the change that shipped before it; and entity_client_links, auto_journal_suggestions and engagement_letters, which nothing in the API, the browser or a database function writes.
# 605 closes customer_payment_links, customer_payments and customer_payment_events (POST-A-008, the payments tranche): the API writes all three with its privileged client since the change that shipped before it.
# 606 closes time_entries, task_recurring_configs, reminders and knowledge_article_versions (POST-A-008, the practice tranche): the API writes all four with its privileged client since the change that shipped before it.
# 607 closes notifications, portal_messages and user_notification_preferences (POST-A-008, the messages tranche): the API writes all three with its privileged client since the change that shipped before it.
